BiblicalUsage: tsᵉbaʻ is the word for to dip. It appears 5 times in Scripture, including Daniel 4:33 and Daniel 5:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsᵉbaʻ because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
